subject: Ahh, the Days of Revenge..
author: Nero Angelo
body:
Nice Rank Zombs.. 73 in the World.. Superb! The way I race now, Id be lucky to get first place in any set.. My boostjumps, drifting, and hand-eye coordination are OFF by a mile now...

 

One fact: I've never got my rank under 80.. Never pursued to go underneath it; everytime I get below 100, I always end up jumping in rooms with Dark, Dogg, Gt, Shout, Roonige, Silky, ....... Ichi, Zombietron, Xandu, Psychedelic, and the other fast players of Revenge who I consistently lose to...

 

------------------------------------

"There's Nero, One of the Twin Angels" - DjSubzero18 (Burnout Revenge Online, 3/ 20/ 2009)
